epsilon_scale_definition: epsilon = selected multiplier times median norm of the initialization critic mean action-gradient on held-out validation transitions; frozen before actor updates
epsilon_selection: maximize held-out development success; tie: minimize collision; tie: maximize discounted return; final tie: smaller epsilon scale
shared_across_methods: minibatch and flow noise streams within each seed
uncertainty_model: one terminal-gradient perturbation per sampled Flow trajectory, shared across all internal Flow steps; the perturbation may differ between trajectories
claims_boundary: pathwise frozen-trajectory robust Hamiltonian target; not a globally coherent delta(s,a1) field or a proven robust-policy improvement
